name: AcceptPartnerRequest
story: As an editor, I want to accept a design partner's request for a repository or Foundry project, so that Software Foundry files it as an issue with the partner and its product named.
query:
mutation AcceptPartnerRequest($input: AcceptPartnerRequestInput!) {
  acceptPartnerRequest(input: $input) {
    id
    requestId
    revision
    status
    kind
    title
    productId
    partner
    foundryRequest
    updatedAt
  }
}

name: ArchiveProject
story: As a member, I want to archive a project without deleting its issues or documents, so that its history stays available.
query:
mutation ArchiveProject($input: ArchiveProjectInput!) {
  archiveProject(input: $input) {
    id
    name
    githubRepository
    goals
    userStories
    pressRelease
    demoInstructions
    demoResults
    archived
    revision
  }
}

name: ChangeDigestSchedule
story: As an editor, I want to turn the morning digest of every project on or off, so that the team gets a daily summary of what shipped and what is prioritized without anyone clicking.

mcp.description: Enable or disable the existing daily report chain schedule; editors only.

name: ChangeProductReportSchedule
story: As an editor, I want to enable daily regeneration of the weekly roadmap, so that the working report stays current.

mcp.description: Enable or disable daily roadmap regeneration at 13:00 UTC. Editors only.

name: ClaimWork
story: As an assigned agent, I want to claim a route's work and receive its deterministic context, so that I work on current sources and approved prerequisites without colliding with another holder.

mcp.description: Claim assigned research, architecture or prioritization work with a stable requestId; returns the claim token and deterministic context.

name: CreateIntake
story: As an editor, I want to capture a customer or competitive intake from the intake page or an agent and have it routed, so that the right discovery and delivery work starts under Governance.
query:
mutation CreateIntake($input: CreateIntakeInput!) {
  createIntake(input: $input) {
    id
    revision
    projectId
    kind
    title
    description
    sourceUrls
    sources
    originatingMessage
    releaseFit
    releaseFitHistory
    routing
    routingError
    routes {
      id
      revision
      kind
      dependsOn
      rationale
      gate {
        installationId
        controlId
      }
      blocker
      claim {
        principal
        until
      }
      draft
      result
      observedAt
      gateReceipt
      gateError
      receipt
      submissionIntent
      subject
    }
  }
}

mcp.description: Persist an intake with a stable requestId and optional originatingMessage provenance, then propose governed child work. Retry the identical input with the same requestId.

name: CreateIssue
story: As a member, I want to add a stone, pebble or sand issue to a project from the project page or an agent, so that the team's work is broken down where everyone sees it.
query:
mutation CreateIssue($input: CreateIssueInput!) {
  createIssue(input: $input) {
    id
    projectId
    parentId
    title
    description
    category
    status
    assigneeId
    dueDate
    position
    revision
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}

name: CreateProject
story: As a member, I want to create a project with its goals, user stories, press release and demo documents from the projects page or an agent, so that the team plans from one shared outcome.
query:
mutation CreateProject($input: CreateProjectInput!) {
  createProject(input: $input) {
    id
    name
    githubRepository
    goals
    userStories
    pressRelease
    demoInstructions
    demoResults
    archived
    revision
    openIssues
    updatedAt
    requirementChanges
    preparation
    run
    instructions
  }
}

name: DailyReport
story: As a member or a personal overview workflow, I want this scope's daily report with exact source revisions and coverage, so that an overview depends on persisted source outcomes.

mcp.description: Read this owner's exact daily report for a local date, with source coverage, project dependencies and pinned Wiki revision.

name: DailyReports
story: As a personal overview workflow, I want one daily report outcome per authorized Planning scope including missing reports, so that dependent reports can wait on exact persisted organization outcomes.

mcp.description: Read daily report outcomes across authorized Planning scopes, preserving missing source rows for dependency readiness.

name: DeleteIssue
story: As a member, I want to delete an issue that is no longer needed, so that the project shows only live work.

name: DeleteProject
story: As a member, I want to delete an empty project, so that abandoned projects leave the list.

name: DigestRuns
story: As a member, I want to see whether a digest is still running or failed, so that I know whether to wait or open its run.

mcp.description: Read daily digest/report run progress and failures.

name: DigestSchedule
story: As an editor, I want to see whether the morning digest is on and when it runs next, so that I know the team will get one.

mcp.description: Read the existing daily owner report chain schedule.

name: GenerateDailyReports
story: As an editor, I want all active project reports for a selected recovery date or previous local day followed by this owner's overview in one durable run, so that failures remain visible and retries preserve captured reports.

mcp.description: Start the same-owner daily report chain for a completed recovery date or previous local day as one durable registered task; editors only.

name: GenerateProductReport
story: As an editor, I want to regenerate the selected or current week's product roadmap in a registered workflow, so that updated graph evidence informs a draft for review.

mcp.description: Start the registered product roadmap summary workflow for the selected at date or current week. Editors only.

name: GenerateProjectDigest
story: As an editor, I want to start a project's digest now from its Daily digest page or an agent, so that I can catch up on what changed since the last one without waiting for the morning; the platform runs it and keeps its run.

mcp.description: Start the registered digest task for one project and save its previous-local-day report; editors only.

name: IntakeReleaseOptions
story: As an editor, I want the intake project's existing Releases and their revisions, so that I choose a real Release when recording release fit.

mcp.description: Read existing project-linked Release records and revisions before deciding release fit. Does not create Releases.

name: Intakes
story: As an agent, I want the intakes with their routed work, each route's blocker and draft, and the active Governance work gates, so that I can find work that is ready, see which routes are gated, and follow review and delivery.
query:
query Intakes($first: Int = 20, $after: String) {
  intakeOptions
  intakes(first: $first, after: $after) {
    nodes {
      id
      revision
      projectId
      kind
      title
      description
      sourceUrls
      sources
      originatingMessage
      releaseFit
      releaseFitHistory
      routing
      routingError
      routes {
        id
        revision
        kind
        dependsOn
        rationale
        gate {
          installationId
          controlId
        }
        blocker
        claim {
          principal
          until
        }
        draft
        result
        observedAt
        gateReceipt
        gateError
        receipt
        submissionIntent
        subject
      }
    }
    pageInfo {
      endCursor
      hasNextPage
    }
  }
}

mcp.description: Read persisted conversational intakes, release fit and history, routed discovery, blockers and delivery receipts. Read IDs and revisions before writing.

name: IntakeWorkPreview
story: As an editor or assigned agent, I want to preview an intake's implementation work package with its approved discovery records, so that I submit exactly the package I reviewed.

mcp.description: Preview ready implementation with current discovery sources and release-fit revision. Changes nothing.

name: IntakeWorkPreviews

name: PriorityOrder

name: SaveResultDraft
story: As an assigned agent, I want to keep saving my findings to a draft under my claim as I research, so that the evidence builds up without asking for review until I submit it with RecordResult.

name: SaveUseCase
story: As an editor, I want to write or revise a project's use case from the use cases page or an agent, so that it lives in the Wiki linked to the project.

name: SetIntakeReleaseFit
story: As an editor, I want to record how a conversational intake fits an existing project Release, or defer it in backlog, so that discovery and delivery use the persisted decision and its rationale.

name: SetProjectState
story: As a member, I want to change a project lifecycle state, so that the projects list reflects the work status.

mcp.description: Change a project lifecycle state using its current revision, including restoring an archived project.

name: SubmitDeliveryPackage

name: SubmitIntakeWork
